docs.summary: Collects the events sampled over one update and answers simple queries. Graph nodes record the range each subtree produced so blends can weight them.
Goes up with every change to the buffer: an event added, or one reweighted, ignored, mirrored or moved to the inactive branch. A reader that cached an answer can tell it may be out of date.
An empty range at the current end of the buffer, where the next events will be added.
Adds an event sampled at full weight from the active branch.
